title: samere me ghul hai bapa haaye haaye
body:
samere me ghul hai bapa haaye haaye
askari ne ki hai qaza haaye haaye
kehte hai sar peet ke saahib zamaa'n
wa abata wa abata haaaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
zehre dagha se kiya zalim ne qatl
aapko be jurm o qata haaye haaye
ehle haram rote hai sar peet kar
warise mehboobe quda haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch na kiya paas imaame zamaa'n
baitul sharaf loot liya haaye haaye
hogaye bin baap ke sahib zamaa'n
waasafa waasafa haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
saaya e paake shahe hadi e hashr
momino ke sar se utha haaye haaye
